# 大乘入道次第

**Category:** 瑜伽部類

**Byline:** 唐 智周撰
**Dynasty:** 唐

**Juans:** 1

## Contributors
- 智周 (A006125)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-fascicle systematic treatise by [智周](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E5%91%A8) **Zhìzhōu** (668–723), the third patriarch of the Cí'ēn-school, laying out the bodhisattva-path in stages (*cìdì* 次第 = *krama*) within the Yogācāra-Cí'ēn doctrinal framework. Preserved in the *Taishō* at T45n1864. Functions as an introductory practice-manual to the bodhisattva-path complementing Huìzhǎo's [KR6n0127](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0127) *Quànfā pútí xīn jí*.

**Abstract**

The *Rùdào cìdì* is a compact didactic treatment of the Mahāyāna path, designed to be intelligible to monks beginning Yogācāra study. It systematically presents the *path* (*dào* = *mārga*) in its standard Yogācāra five-stage form — *zīliángdào* 資糧道 (path of accumulation), *jiāxíngdào* 加行道 (path of preparation), *jiàndào* 見道 (path of seeing), *xiūdào* 修道 (path of cultivation), *jiūjìngdào* 究竟道 (path of completion) — together with the analyses of the *èrzhàng* (twofold obscuration) cut at each, and the *èrkōng* (twofold emptiness) realised at each. The work is characteristic of the third-generation Cí'ēn-school's effort to consolidate the doctrinal apparatus of [玄奘](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%84%E5%A5%98) and [窺基](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AA%BA%E5%9F%BA) into pedagogically accessible practice manuals.

The dating window 700–723 brackets Zhìzhōu's productive period as third patriarch of the Cí'ēn-school. The work was sufficiently authoritative that the Héxī Cí'ēn-school monk [曇曠](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9B%87%E6%9B%A0) composed an extended *kāijué* (decisional supplement) on it — [KR6n0130](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0130) *Dàshèng rùdào cìdì kāijué* — at Dūnhuáng in the third quarter of the eighth century.
